answer: Allot each operator a single cultivated bed in a public garden of voting weight, grown only by attested work, so minting extra keys plants nothing. A new address must first occupy a single-file admission ledge for two epochs and answer live challenges that expire in minutes; a farm of unattended clones will miss those windows. Collateral for the wait is locked in a sable vault the applicant cannot inspect, then revealed to auditors who cluster by payer. Keys that share a funder collapse into one bed, and surplus stake is paid to the graders who exposed them.
